$comment: Agent notes for chat administration: members, rights, invite links, join requests. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite.

banChatMember.purpose: Ban a user from a group, supergroup or channel, for good or until a date.
use_when: removing a user permanently or for a limited time
avoid_when: a channel posting under its own name: banChatSenderChat
removing a member who may rejoin: unbanChatMember

pitfalls.text: until_date is a Unix timestamp, not a duration, and applies to supergroups and channels only; under 30 s or over 366 days from now means forever.
pitfalls.cite: until_date: If user is banned for more than 366 days or less than 30 seconds from the current time they are considered to be banned forever.

pitfalls.text: In supergroups and channels the user cannot return via invite links until unbanned.
pitfalls.cite: banChatMember: the user will not be able to return to the chat on their own using invite links, etc., unless unbanned first

pitfalls.text: A ban is public and hard to undo socially: log who and why, confirm with a human admin.

banChatMember.rights: admin with can_restrict_members (ChatAdministratorRights: restrict, ban or unban members)

unbanChatMember.purpose: Lift a ban, or remove a member so the user can rejoin; only_if_banned makes it a no-op for non-banned users.
use_when: a ban should end early
removing a member without keeping them banned

pitfalls.text: Without only_if_banned a current member is removed from the chat.
pitfalls.cite: unbanChatMember: if the user is a member of the chat they will also be removed from the chat. If you don't want this, use the parameter only_if_banned.

pitfalls.text: The user does not return automatically; they can join via a link.
pitfalls.cite: unbanChatMember: The user will not return to the group or channel automatically, but will be able to join via link, etc.

unbanChatMember.rights: admin with can_restrict_members (ChatAdministratorRights: restrict, ban or unban members)

banChatSenderChat.purpose: Ban a channel identity in a supergroup or channel so its owner cannot send as any of their channels.
use_when: messages arrive on behalf of a channel (Message.sender_chat) and must stop

pitfalls.text: The ban covers the owner: no sending on behalf of any of their channels until unbanChatSenderChat.
pitfalls.cite: banChatSenderChat: the owner of the banned chat won't be able to send messages on behalf of any of their channels

banChatSenderChat.rights: admin with can_restrict_members (ChatAdministratorRights: restrict, ban or unban members)

unbanChatSenderChat.purpose: Lift the ban of a channel identity in a supergroup or channel.
use_when: a banned channel may send as itself again
unbanChatSenderChat.rights: admin with can_restrict_members (ChatAdministratorRights: restrict, ban or unban members)

restrictChatMember.purpose: Set what one user may do in a supergroup; all permissions True lifts the restriction.
use_when: mute or limit a member, e.g. no media for a day
lift a restriction

pitfalls.text: Without use_independent_chat_permissions, can_send_other_messages and can_add_web_page_previews imply can_send_messages and the media rights; can_send_polls implies can_send_messages.
pitfalls.cite: use_independent_chat_permissions: Pass True if chat permissions are set independently. Otherwise, the can_send_other_messages and can_add_web_page_previews permissions will imply...

pitfalls.text: until_date is a Unix timestamp; under 30 s or over 366 days from now means forever.
pitfalls.cite: until_date: ...restricted for more than 366 days or less than 30 seconds from the current time, they are considered to be restricted forever.

restrictChatMember.rights: admin with can_restrict_members (ChatAdministratorRights: restrict, ban or unban members)

promoteChatMember.purpose: Promote a user to administrator with chosen rights, or demote with False for every right.
use_when: giving a moderator a limited set of rights
demoting: False for all boolean parameters

pitfalls.text: Some rights are channel-only (can_post_messages, can_edit_messages, can_manage_direct_messages), supergroup-only (can_pin_messages, can_manage_topics) or group/supergroup-only (can_manage_tags).
pitfalls.cite: can_pin_messages: ...for supergroups only; can_post_messages: ...for channels only

pitfalls.text: can_restrict_members defaults to True for channel administrators.
pitfalls.cite: can_restrict_members: For backward compatibility, defaults to True for promotions of channel administrators.

pitfalls.text: Grant only rights the bot holds itself; read its own ChatMemberAdministrator flags first.

promoteChatMember.rights: admin with can_promote_members (grants a subset of its own rights)

setChatAdministratorCustomTitle.purpose: Set the custom title of an administrator the bot promoted in a supergroup.
use_when: a visible role label for a promoted moderator

pitfalls.text: Works only for administrators promoted by the bot.
pitfalls.cite: setChatAdministratorCustomTitle: an administrator in a supergroup promoted by the bot

pitfalls.text: custom_title is 0-16 characters, emoji are not allowed.
pitfalls.cite: custom_title: New custom title for the administrator; 0-16 characters, emoji are not allowed

setChatMemberTag.purpose: Set the tag of a regular member in a group or supergroup.
use_when: a visible role label for a regular member

pitfalls.text: tag is 0-16 characters, emoji are not allowed; regular members only.
pitfalls.cite: tag: New tag for the member; 0-16 characters, emoji are not allowed

pitfalls.text: Members edit their own tag only with can_edit_tag, which defaults to can_pin_messages.
pitfalls.cite: ChatPermissions.can_edit_tag: allowed to edit their own tag. If omitted, defaults to the value of can_pin_messages.

setChatPermissions.purpose: Set the default permissions of all non-administrator members of a group or supergroup.
use_when: the same limits for every member, e.g. text only

pitfalls.text: Without use_independent_chat_permissions, can_send_other_messages and can_add_web_page_previews imply can_send_messages and the media rights.
pitfalls.cite: use_independent_chat_permissions: Pass True if chat permissions are set independently. Otherwise, the can_send_other_messages and can_add_web_page_previews permissions will imply...

pitfalls.text: can_change_info and can_pin_messages are ignored in public supergroups.
pitfalls.cite: ChatPermissions.can_change_info: Ignored in public supergroups.

createChatInviteLink.purpose: Create an additional invite link for a chat, optionally named, expiring, limited or approval-gated.
use_when: one link per campaign or source
joins that need approval: creates_join_request

pitfalls.text: creates_join_request and member_limit cannot be combined.
pitfalls.cite: creates_join_request: If True, member_limit can't be specified.

pitfalls.text: name 0-32 characters, member_limit 1-99999.
pitfalls.cite: name: Invite link name; 0-32 characters; member_limit: ...1-99999

pitfalls.text: Each administrator has their own links; the bot can use only links it generated.
pitfalls.cite: exportChatInviteLink: Bots can't use invite links generated by other administrators.

createChatInviteLink.rights: admin; can_invite_users is the inviting right (the method says only 'appropriate rights')

editChatInviteLink.purpose: Change the name, expiry, member limit or approval mode of a non-primary link the bot created.
use_when: a campaign link needs a new limit or name

pitfalls.text: Only non-primary links created by the bot can be edited.
pitfalls.cite: editChatInviteLink: edit a non-primary invite link created by the bot

pitfalls.text: creates_join_request and member_limit cannot be combined.
pitfalls.cite: creates_join_request: If True, member_limit can't be specified.

pitfalls.text: name 0-32 characters; member_limit 1-99999.
pitfalls.cite: name: 0-32 characters; member_limit: 1-99999

editChatInviteLink.rights: admin; can_invite_users is the inviting right (the method says only 'appropriate rights')

createChatSubscriptionInviteLink.purpose: Create a paid subscription invite link for a channel, charged in Telegram Stars each period.
use_when: monthly paid access to a channel

pitfalls.text: subscription_period must always be 2592000 (30 days).
pitfalls.cite: subscription_period: Currently, it must always be 2592000 (30 days).

pitfalls.text: subscription_price is 1-10000 Stars, paid initially and after each period.
pitfalls.cite: subscription_price: The amount of Telegram Stars a user must pay initially and after each subsequent subscription period...; 1-10000

pitfalls.text: Later: rename with editChatSubscriptionInviteLink, revoke with revokeChatInviteLink.
pitfalls.cite: createChatSubscriptionInviteLink: can be edited using the method editChatSubscriptionInviteLink or revoked using the method revokeChatInviteLink

editChatSubscriptionInviteLink.purpose: Rename a subscription invite link the bot created.
use_when: relabelling a paid channel link

pitfalls.text: Only name is editable; the method takes no period or price.
pitfalls.cite: editChatSubscriptionInviteLink parameters: chat_id, invite_link, name

revokeChatInviteLink.purpose: Revoke an invite link the bot created.
use_when: a link was leaked or its campaign ended

pitfalls.text: Revoking the primary link generates a new one automatically.
pitfalls.cite: revokeChatInviteLink: If the primary link is revoked, a new link is automatically generated.

pitfalls.text: Only links the bot created; other administrators' links are off limits.
pitfalls.cite: revokeChatInviteLink: revoke an invite link created by the bot

pitfalls.text: A revoked link is dead for everyone who already got it; record who held it.

revokeChatInviteLink.rights: admin; can_invite_users is the inviting right (the method says only 'appropriate rights')

exportChatInviteLink.purpose: Generate a new primary invite link for a chat; the previous primary link is revoked.
use_when: the bot needs its own working link
replacing the bot's earlier primary link
avoid_when: extra links per source or campaign: createChatInviteLink

pitfalls.text: Returns the link as a plain String, not a ChatInviteLink.
pitfalls.cite: exportChatInviteLink: Returns the new invite link as String on success.

pitfalls.text: Any previously generated primary link is revoked.
pitfalls.cite: exportChatInviteLink: any previously generated primary link is revoked

pitfalls.text: Each administrator generates their own links; the bot needs its own, from this method or getChat.
pitfalls.cite: exportChatInviteLink: Bots can't use invite links generated by other administrators.

exportChatInviteLink.rights: admin; can_invite_users is the inviting right (the method says only 'appropriate rights')

approveChatJoinRequest.purpose: Approve a pending chat join request.
use_when: the applicant passed your checks, e.g. accepted the rules
avoid_when: ChatJoinRequest.query_id is present: the bot must answer that query (answerChatJoinRequestQuery)

pitfalls.text: The bot can message the applicant via user_chat_id for 5 minutes until the request is processed, if no other administrator contacted them.
pitfalls.cite: ChatJoinRequest.user_chat_id: The bot can use this identifier for 5 minutes to send messages until the join request is processed

declineChatJoinRequest.purpose: Decline a pending chat join request.
use_when: the applicant failed your checks
avoid_when: ChatJoinRequest.query_id is present: the bot must answer that query (answerChatJoinRequestQuery)

pitfalls.text: user_chat_id messaging lasts 5 minutes and ends once the request is processed, so send any reason before declining.
pitfalls.cite: ChatJoinRequest.user_chat_id: The bot can use this identifier for 5 minutes to send messages until the join request is processed

sendChatJoinRequestWebApp.purpose: Show a Mini App to the applicant of a join request query before deciding the outcome.
use_when: verifying the applicant in a Mini App first
avoid_when: the decision needs no interaction: answerChatJoinRequestQuery directly

pitfalls.text: Only for bots assigned to process join requests; call within 10 seconds of ChatJoinRequest.query_id arriving.
pitfalls.cite: ChatJoinRequest.query_id: for bots assigned to process join requests only... must call sendChatJoinRequestWebApp or directly call answerChatJoinRequestQuery within 10 seconds.

pitfalls.text: Resolve afterwards with answerChatJoinRequestQuery; Telegram's docs state no deadline for that final answer.
web_app_url must be an HTTPS URL.
pitfalls.cite: web_app_url: An HTTPS URL of a Web App

answerChatJoinRequestQuery.purpose: Resolve a join request query: approve, decline or queue it for other administrators.
use_when: a bot assigned to process join requests decides at once or after a Mini App
avoid_when: a request without query_id: approveChatJoinRequest or declineChatJoinRequest

pitfalls.text: result is exactly approve, decline or queue; queue leaves the decision to other administrators.
pitfalls.cite: result: Must be either “approve” to allow the user to join the chat, “decline” to disallow the user to join the chat, or “queue” to leave the decision to other administrators.

pitfalls.text: The id is ChatJoinRequest.query_id (a string), not a user id; answer, or show the Mini App, within 10 seconds.
pitfalls.cite: ChatJoinRequest.query_id: the bot must call sendChatJoinRequestWebApp or directly call answerChatJoinRequestQuery within 10 seconds
